scope: IMP-02 / R2 item 325: lift the runtime installation-shape verdict from command generation into the capability layer so the tool list, preview and executor agree
status: implemented-and-isolated-verified; no real manager was updated
gapClosed: The runtime installation verdict existed only inside self_update_command, so the tool list still judged updatability from the static catalog. A Corepack-managed pnpm or a pip-installed uv rendered as updatable and was refused only after the user opened the preview.

implementation.singleSource: self_update_channel_blocker(tool, inv) is now the only place that turns UpdateChannel into user-facing text; the executor and the tool list both call it, so their reasons cannot drift
implementation.capabilityField: ToolConfig gains selfUpdateBlocker (serde default), filled during get_tool_configs from the same resolved Invocation
implementation.uiGating: The 更新当前工具 button is disabled when selfUpdateBlocker is set and its title shows that reason; the version panel renders an explicit '此安装的自更新不可用' line
implementation.backwardCompatibility: The field is #[serde(default)] and optional in TypeScript, so an older snapshot without it deserializes to None rather than failing

fixtures.name: pkgtools::tests::list_preview_and_executor_share_one_self_update_blocker
asserts: the blocker string from the list path equals the executor's error string for a Corepack shim
the same equality holds for a pip-installed uv
a standalone installation yields no blocker, so the list cannot invent one

fixtures.name: pkgtools::tests::tool_config_exposes_the_runtime_blocker_over_ipc
asserts: the field serializes under the camelCase name selfUpdateBlocker
a snapshot without the field deserializes to None instead of failing

notVerified: No real Corepack-managed manager exists in this environment, so the disabled-button path is proven by fixture and by the shared-function equality, not by clicking a real installation
The UI rendering is now covered: the fixture lists a Corepack-blocked pnpm, asserts the update button is disabled, the reason line renders, and the button title carries the same text
limitations: composer and bun still have no installation-shape check and are treated as Standalone
The Corepack heuristic reads the launcher body; a shim invoking corepack through another wrapper is not detected
The batch preview re-derives readiness from the same blocker, but the batch UI was not re-exercised with a blocked-at-runtime manager
